notes.title: Singleplayer Overhaul and NEW Trailer on the Steampage!
notes.content:
[h1]Hey all, I'm back with a brand new Blockhead 2D update![/h1]

Today's upload includes incredible CPU fixes! Every character in the singleplayer mode has their own unique strategy:

[i][b]James [/b]is tactical and careful with his movement, using his burps to push himself towards or away from you. Beware of his speedy MEGA BURP, which kills you if you're in the way.[/i]

[i][b]Jill [/b]is persistent and fast. She will chase you and if she inflicts damage, she won't stop. If Jill is injured, you'll contend with a scream that makes her even more aggressive.[/i]

[i][b]Jack [/b]is calculating and with every jump he ensures that he's a platform above; He is especially adept at jumping off the players' head to stomp them. When he is injured, you must keep a fair distance away to avoid his demonic screeching, which will kill you instantly if you're too close.[/i]

[i][b]Jeb[/b], although somewhat mindless in his strategy and usually easy to kill, he is good at air attacks. Never be above Jeb when he's preparing to execute his MEGA FART, which will destroy anyone above him.[/i]

Another change also includes being able to select the [b]house [/b] and its three variations from the singleplayer menu, with the [b]Gym [/b]also being available as an extra.

I had a great time making this update and I hope everyone has just as much fun playing it!
Also, here's a new trailer showcasing all the characters and their abilities!

[previewyoutube=pzwsudh1wd0;full][/previewyoutube]

tags.feature: Another change also includes being able to select the [b]house [/b] and its three variations from the singleplayer menu, with the [b]Gym [/b]also being available as an extra.

notes.title: Happy St. Patrick's Day!
notes.content:
[h1]Top of the morning to ya![/h1] 

Help the Blockhead Family find the pot of gold in this new update. Beware however, for [b]LEPRECHAUNZ[/b] will chase you down to protect his gold!

Watch out! He throws whiskey bottles with incredible accuracy. Never stand still!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42596776/cd347000527d3ddbd43317c86d44333f18961d97.gif[/img]

Not only is he deadly with his alcoholic projectiles, getting close is no laughing matter. If he pokes you, you're dead!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42596776/d06f372d81d4d66d3563668d8ac2d93db5ad0b7f.gif[/img]

Also, unlike other updates, Leprechaunz speaks Gaelic to taunt the player.

[b]Changelog:[/b]

- [i] NEW St. Patrick's Update [/i]

- [i] Fixed time elapsed not showing up for Valentines Day minigame end screen [/i]

- [i] Added collisions to different objects (also walljumpable) [/i]\

- [i] In the St. Patrick's Day mode, you can hide in the teacups in the kitchen and the beer mug on the shelf to get away from Leprechaunz. [/i]

And that's all! Have fun. :)

- Kyvati Studios

For the beginning of the year, I've decided to expand the level size even [b]further[/b] with a bathroom! Do you think there should be a bedroom?

Here are some peeks of the bathroom! This is a harder level to get around, as it does require more walljumping skill. There's even a secret in the sink drain...

notes.title: Singleplayer Improvements!
notes.content:
The singleplayer wasn't the most-focused-on thing on Blockhead 2D, but I made some minor changes to the CPU in the training including:



[h1]*There's now absolutely NO chance that the CPUs will pass through objects.[/h1]

[h1]*Jack will trick you in the corners, now and maneuver himself so he jumps on you instead of him.[/h1]

[h1]*Fixed Jack's collisions so that we won't hit you by "jumping down" into your collision boxes.[/h1]

That's pretty much it! Have fun and enjoy the game, as usual! :D
